defects: h_infinite_v and h_infinite_w are tautologies (v x = 0 ∨ v x ≠ 0 is true by excluded middle for any function v), so they fail entirely to encode the notion of 'infinite place'

K and E are not required to be number fields, and v, w are arbitrary ℝ-valued Valuations, not InfinitePlace's (archimedean absolute values up to equivalence) — loses the number-theoretic structure of the problem
no LiesOver relation between w and v is used; h_extends (w ∘ algebraMap = v) is a weaker, non-equivalent substitute that doesn't capture the LiesOver typeclass structure used in the gold

h_unramified (∃ y : K, w (x - algebraMap K E y) < 1) does not formalize the mathematical definition of an unramified infinite place; it resembles a weak density/approximation condition, not ramification index/local degree equality

conclusion computes Module.rank K (UniformSpace.Completion E) instead of Module.finrank v.Completion w.Completion — uses K instead of the completion of K at v, and the generic UniformSpace.Completion E instead of the completion of E with respect to the specific valuation w
uses Module.rank (cardinal-valued) instead of Module.finrank (natural-number-valued) as in the gold, a signature mismatch
overall the produced statement is a different, non-equivalent ad-hoc formalization rather than an equivalent restatement of the gold
